description: This file defines a custom exception class InterestRateChartNotFoundException used for handling cases where an interest rate chart is not found within the application. It extends a core exception class and provides constructors for exception handling with relevant messages.

classes.name: InterestRateChartNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating that an interest rate chart with a specific identifier does not exist.

methods.name: InterestRateChartNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that accepts an ID and constructs an exception message indicating the interest rate chart with that ID does not exist.

methods.name: InterestRateChartNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that accepts an ID and an underlying exception, allowing chaining of exceptions.
